text:
Priya Rao: Morning — final call on Wed 10:00am PST training for NovaHealth onboarding. Need final headcount and owners for slides.
Liam Chen: I can take the "Intro + Prod setup" section. Headcount pings from the CS notes are ~18.
Sasha Ortiz: I'll handle the hands-on lab (dedicated -> private deploy examples). Need a pre-demo checklist.
Priya Rao: Thanks @Liam @Sasha — can you drop slide links? Agenda draft: 
```
10:00 - 10:10 Welcome + objectives (Priya)
10:10 - 10:30 Intro + prod setup (Liam)
10:30 - 11:05 Hands-on lab (Sasha)
11:05 - 11:25 Q&A + renewal-risk review (Priya/Noah)
11:25 - 11:30 Next steps + feedback survey
```
Noah Patel: I'll lead the renewal-risk section — will surface the playbook + open action items. Also need customer decision-makers list.
Priya Rao: We have 2 execs, tech lead, and platform eng. Can you confirm contacts @Noah?
Noah Patel: Confirmed — added names in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. I'll DM the execs to confirm attendance.
Liam Chen: Slide deck link: https://drive.google.com/example — added notes for the prod setup. Also adding a quick troubleshooting slide for common provisioning fails.
Sasha Ortiz: For hands-on lab, can we shorten to 35 mins? 30 might be tight if people need provisioning. Suggest 35 with 15-min buffer.
Priya Rao: ok adjusting agenda. pls update doc; I'll update calendar invite and add Zoom + breakout rooms.
cs-helper-bot: poll posted — 'Preferred lab time: 30 vs 35 mins' — results 35m: 12, 30m: 6 :thumbsup: 
Priya Rao: Great — locking 35m. @Liam @Sasha please confirm any infra pref (token access, sample datasets) by EOD Monday.
Liam Chen: Token instructions added under /notes/token-setup.md and sample dataset uploaded to S3 link.
Sasha Ortiz: I need the sample dataset trimmed — current size too big for some attendees. Will post a trimmed version by tonight.
Noah Patel: Also adding a 1-slide renewal-risk mitigation template we can share. Will attach before the session.
Priya Rao: Thanks team. Final attendee count 18; calendar invite sent to all. Quick ask: can someone own post-training feedback capture? I'd like a short 3-question survey.
Liam Chen: I'll own survey + results, will use Typeform and share results next week.
Priya Rao: perfect — Marking this thread resolved once slides + lab trimmed are uploaded. :white_check_mark:
Sasha Ortiz: uploaded trimmed dataset, updated lab runbook.
Liam Chen: survey draft: https://typeform.com/example — comments welcome.
Priya Rao: Awesome. Thanks everyone!
